SharePilot 1.2.0 (build 18) is a commercial release with a seven-day full-feature trial and Paddle licence activation. Requires macOS 26.0 or later; supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
## Changes
### Added
- In-app updates through Sparkle, with automatic daily checks, release notes, and installation and relaunch. Use **Check for Updates…** from the app menu or the menu-bar panel's More options menu. **Update Settings…** includes optional automatic downloading and installation. - Signed update feeds and downloads, restricted to the app's current major version. Future paid major upgrades cannot replace your licensed version automatically.
### Fixed
- Queued disconnects recheck the exact network mount before unmounting and refuse symlink redirection. Busy volumes remain protected by normal, non-forced macOS unmounts. - Changing a connection keeps its previous saved password until replacement settings have been saved successfully. - Closing the menu-bar panel and settings window releases their views, avoiding retained background observers.
Personal builds keep licensing disabled without reading or changing saved trial/licence records. In-app production updates are disabled in personal, sandbox and trial-preview builds.
Existing SharePilot 1 licences cover this update. No checkout or entitlement changes.
[Full changelog](https://github.com/deanc/SharePilot-releases/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
